about.text: A cow's-milk pâte solubilisée cheese named after mizotte, a salt-marsh grass of the flooded Vendée marshes, with its rind washed in white wine. It was made at Saint-Michel-en-l'Herm (Vendée) until early 2016, and SAVENCIA has since restarted it in Dordogne.

sources.text: The milk, the rind, the origin and the production history, from the article.
